# WAS_KernelCCA_base { #wass2s.WAS_KernelCCA_base }

```python
WAS_KernelCCA_base(
    n_modes=4,
    kernel='linear',
    dist_method='nonparam',
    standardize=True,
    cv_folds=3,
    random_state=42,
    search_method='grid',
    reg=1e-06,
    pca_explained_variance=0.8,
    pca_min_components=None,
    pca_whiten=False,
    pca_backend='xeofs',
    pca_use_coslat=False,
    pca_solver='auto',
)
```

Shared base for kernel CCA seasonal-forecast models (KCCA, KGCCA).

Subclasses only need to implement the model-construction hooks:
    _build_model(params)      -> a fitted-ready cca-zoo estimator
    _grid_estimator()         -> estimator used by GridSearchCV
    _prepare_param_grid()     -> dict for grid search
    _objective(trial, X, Y)   -> float for Optuna (optional)
    _is_linear_kernel()       -> whether interpretable feature weights exist

Conventions identical to WAS_CCA_base:
    WAS dims:  T, Y, X
    Predictand standardized before CCA, returned in original scale.
    Missing values filled with training-period means (no leakage).

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [compute_hyperparameters](#wass2s.WAS_KernelCCA_base.compute_hyperparameters) | Find best kernel hyperparameters; stores them in self.best_params. |
| [compute_model](#wass2s.WAS_KernelCCA_base.compute_model) | Fit on the training fold and predict the test fold. Returns the |
| [fit_cca](#wass2s.WAS_KernelCCA_base.fit_cca) | Fit the kernel CCA model and build the (X canonical scores -> Y field) |
| [get_components](#wass2s.WAS_KernelCCA_base.get_components) | Spatial patterns (linear kernel only). |
| [plot_cca_results](#wass2s.WAS_KernelCCA_base.plot_cca_results) | Plot canonical scores (always) and spatial modes (linear kernel). |

### compute_hyperparameters { #wass2s.WAS_KernelCCA_base.compute_hyperparameters }

```python
WAS_KernelCCA_base.compute_hyperparameters(
    Predictors,
    Predictand,
    clim_year_start=None,
    clim_year_end=None,
)
```

Find best kernel hyperparameters; stores them in self.best_params.

### compute_model { #wass2s.WAS_KernelCCA_base.compute_model }

```python
WAS_KernelCCA_base.compute_model(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    X_test,
    y_test,
    best_params=None,
)
```

Fit on the training fold and predict the test fold. Returns the
deterministic hindcast in the original predictand scale (T, Y, X).

### fit_cca { #wass2s.WAS_KernelCCA_base.fit_cca }

```python
WAS_KernelCCA_base.fit_cca(X_train, y_train, best_params=None)
```

Fit the kernel CCA model and build the (X canonical scores -> Y field)
regression used for deterministic prediction.

`y_train` is used *as given* as the regression target, so callers that
want predictions in standardized space should pass a standardized
predictand (see compute_model / forecast).

### get_components { #wass2s.WAS_KernelCCA_base.get_components }

```python
WAS_KernelCCA_base.get_components()
```

Spatial patterns (linear kernel only).

### plot_cca_results { #wass2s.WAS_KernelCCA_base.plot_cca_results }

```python
WAS_KernelCCA_base.plot_cca_results(
    X=None,
    Y=None,
    n_modes=None,
    clim_year_start=None,
    clim_year_end=None,
    best_params=None,
)
```

Plot canonical scores (always) and spatial modes (linear kernel).
